post_title: How many attack drones will Russia launch at Ukraine on the night of October 29–30, 2026?

question.title: How many attack drones will Russia launch at Ukraine on the night of October 29–30, 2026?
question.description:
Since 2022 Russia has carried out near-nightly long-range drone and missile strikes on Ukraine, primarily using Iranian-designed Shahed-type one-way attack drones alongside Gerbera and Parodiya decoy drones. Each morning Ukraine's Air Force (Повітряні Сили ЗСУ) publishes on its official Telegram channel a summary of the previous night's attack, stating how many drones and missiles were launched/detected and how many were shot down or electronically suppressed. These figures are routinely relayed by Ukrinform, RBC-Ukraine, the Kyiv Independent, and other outlets.

Nightly launch totals vary widely. In early-to-mid October 2026, many nights saw roughly 130–200 attack drones (e.g., 135 on Oct 4, 137 on Oct 5/6, 130 on Oct 7, 142 on Oct 8, 136 on Oct 9, 128 on Oct 13, 149 on Oct 16), interspersed with large "massive combined" strikes (e.g., 580 drones plus missiles on the night of Oct 15, and "more than 850" drones over the Wednesday–Thursday span of Oct 14–15). In September 2026, Russia launched 450+ drones on Sept 13 and over 400 in a 12-hour daytime window on Sept 12, and deployed over 3,177 jet-powered drones during the month. Russia's winter campaign against Ukraine's energy infrastructure began in late September 2026, and the overall trend through 2026 has been toward larger and more frequent barrages.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the number of attack drones (Shahed-type strike UAVs, Gerbera drones, Parodiya/Parody decoy drones, and similar one-way attack/decoy UAVs) that the Ukrainian Air Force (Повітряні Сили ЗСУ) reports Russia launched at Ukraine during the overnight attack that began the evening of October 29, 2026 (Kyiv time) and is summarized in the Air Force's morning report of October 30, 2026. The figure is the total number of drones/UAVs detected as launched (not the number shot down), as reported by the Ukrainian Air Force and relayed by [Ukrinform's war news feed](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/block-lastnews) or other [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions). For example, a report stating "Russia launched 580 Shahed-type attack UAVs, Gerbera drones, and Parodiya-type decoy drones overnight" resolves as 580. Cruise/ballistic/other missiles are excluded from the count.
question.fine_print: The relevant count is the launched/detected total for the single overnight period beginning the evening of October 29, 2026 (Kyiv time), as summarized in the Air Force's morning situation report issued on October 30, 2026 — not a daytime update or a multi-day cumulative total. If the Air Force reports a range or revises the figure, the most complete figure attributed to the Air Force for that overnight period is used. If the Ukrainian Air Force does not publish a drone-launch figure for that night anywhere, the question is annulled.
